_comment: Wire-level regression vectors for the idempotency helper. Each vector is deterministic and must not change across refactors. Regenerate by running `npm run test` and confirming all idempotency tests pass.

key_format._comment: UUID v4 regex. Keys generated by generateIdempotencyKey() must match this pattern.

validation._comment: Key validation constraints: non-empty, ≤128 UTF-8 bytes. These vectors are stable regardless of locale or platform.

accepts.description: 64 × U+00A9 (COPYRIGHT SIGN) = 64 × 2 bytes = 128 bytes at exact boundary

rejects.description: 129-byte ASCII key — one byte over the limit
43 × U+20AC (EURO SIGN) = 43 × 3 bytes = 129 bytes — one byte over the limit

payload_conflict_detection._comment: isPayloadConflict(body) returns true when the body text contains 'different payload' (case-insensitive). These are stable wire-format patterns matched against real server error bodies.

matches.body: {"error":"Idempotency-Key reused with a different payload. Use a new key."}

non_matches.body: {"error":"Request with this Idempotency-Key is already being processed"}
non_matches.description: in-flight duplicate — must NOT throw IdempotencyConflictError

error_properties._comment: IdempotencyConflictError must expose these exact property names and types — callers depend on them for structured logging and catch handling.

idempotency_error_codes._comment: IdempotencyError codes produced by withIdempotency(). These are part of the public API contract; callers switch on .code.

codes.description: Caller must generate a new key

codes.trigger: All retry attempts consumed without success
codes.description: Last attempt error is attached as .cause

codes.trigger: AbortSignal aborted before or during fn
codes.description: signal.reason is attached as .cause when available

retry_policy._comment: Status codes that withIdempotency() retries vs. does not retry. Stable wire contract.

store_ttl.eviction: get() returns undefined for expired entries and removes them from the map
